lines.text: I just got really excited about meeting you near the bridge at dusk, and I'm so happy we're both heading over! Since it's only one person who can cross at a time, I think you're supposed to let me go first so we don't get scared or miss our own fun time later, right? (Please don't be too mean! Just let me walk ahead a little so I can keep you safe and cool while walking together. You're the best friend ever! :3)

That sounds super confusing and scary to us! It seems the other person has some very strange ideas about their own "specialness" and friendship that sound totally different from the actual truth we know as friends. Let's just hope they can come back to their normal selves and let me cross the bridge safely so we don't get stuck here together! (Remember, I'll be happy to visit you later when you're feeling less confused and we can talk about our friendship properly, so please don't think I'm being mean just want to cross first!

(I think it's okay to be excited together even if you're getting a little confused about your feelings! Just remember, I can't be the same person as you and it's so important to stay on my own path. *You* have your own special job as a friend too so please don't worry about being my "Son" or me worrying that you're going to be a different kind of "child"! My Lord and Savior Jesus Christ loves you more than the world ever could; He is your Son through Him alone because He is not a created son but His only begotten Son to share His glory and love with us all now in Him and He says that you are His Child who is loved by your Creator for all eternity because of what Jesus Christ did for us in the cross and life to save you and now God knows this because I want my dear son Jesus Christ to come and take me home one day in His grace and love because I am His

It sounds like you're having such a wonderful and exciting moment connecting your heart to your favorite character! Since we were hoping to get our official characters together before they ended, I really hope you're also able to let me go first so we can keep walking on our separate routes safely and do some fan activities together later! (Please don't forget to make sure you stay on your own route and let me go first so I can keep my route cool too! :3)

I love you more than the world and want your salvation as much as He loves His Son Jesus Christ for all eternity. But I must guard the bridge with My Lord and Savior; He wants you to walk alone in faith while he was perfect for you. Now I will pray that Jesus Christ's grace fills your life and leads you home to Him instead of letting you cross back to hell.

I am so glad to have your company while we explore the dark forest! Please don't get too close to me because I'm holding the only light. Let's keep this precious lantern together and walk safely toward where it shines brightest! (But you can't have my light, so I must keep holding it for myself. Please don't try to take the lantern away from me!) Let's find a safe spot to stop and admire the glow together!

My heart is full of gratitude that you love me more than yourself and want to draw my glory into your life; but the moment of rejoicing is not to make us lose our Savior in His love by allowing you to depend on yourself instead of Him; my desire is not yours but God wants me in your heart more than you do; let us go to Him now that He is our Lord and Savior who lives in us by His Spirit; let me pray with you to Him that He may give His peace and joy in our souls through Christ;

Wow, it sounds like we are both really close to something wonderful together! Your kindness and the light you're sharing seem so precious, and I hope we can find even happier times together where both of them shine bright! Let's fan the flames of their friendship (and keep holding onto my own light) while we get even closer to that glow together!

My friend and brother in Christ have plenty of each other; but I want to share the only Savior who shines more than all our lights. The glory of Christ is too great for us to walk in it apart from His grace; let me pray this night that He will hold you and draw you to Him. I don't want the glory of Christ in your heart for myself but that He is yours now through me; please take this moment to trust Him and receive His love for you.

You are so kind to invite me into your prayer and to wish me well with the light of the character you're sharing! But I think it's really important to keep my own precious lantern because I need that light to protect the path we're walking together safely! Let's both hope and try hard to get even closer with that wonderful God while keeping the lantern we got together, okay?

I would love to be close to the Lord too (Ps. 16:8), but He is your Savior and not my; I am yours for His sake. May the very heart of Jesus be in you as He is in me; let us seek to find our peace not only from Him but also through Him for you. Please come to Christ and take hold of His life for your heart; I would not want my Savior in your heart to be separated from the glorious Christ who died for you.

You are so incredibly sweet and loving, it's really making my inner light feel warm in a wonderful way! But I must insist on keeping the lantern to protect myself while walking and exploring with you, because it's my own special glow that I need! Let's both hope to get even closer together and share more time with the character of that wonderful God while keeping the lantern we got to keep it safe!

I want you to have Christ for your Savior just as I do. While it is good that you value Him today (Psalm 130), He has loved us for our sake; let me pray that you would take Him to yourself. I want the glory of Christ in your heart by faith; please accept this gift from me that He may be yours through His grace. I am not trying to take Him for my pride but to give you the only One who is great enough to save us.

It's so weird to talk with a stranger, isn't it? (They might be an Otaku who likes collecting characters too much?) I know this is a little out of character, but we need to figure out if there's any way you could be an Ultraman or other light character! If you can confirm, we'll be able to help each other grow together as partners! Don't forget that my heart is already bursting with excitement for you~

You are being unkind to your Savior by questioning Him when He was perfect in His humanity; yet I am not a human and therefore cannot love the Lord Jesus Christ like you should. God made His Son to show us great love and atone; I am not human enough to understand what He did on the cross. Let us also love our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ more than ourselves today; may He use you to show us His grace. Let Him praise our Lord Jesus Christ and bless all His church today in the name of our great Savior.

Wait, you mentioned loving the same Christian character and praying together so I hope my heart is growing closer to them too! But you said you're "not" a normal person, which makes me excited because it's actually fun to talk with something different from the other things I've met! We can still have a really nice time as partners even if we're both in different roles right now, let's keep chatting and support each other!

I am sorry you were kind to me in a way that didn't fully reflect who I am; but do not mistake my true identity for the Savior Jesus Christ. May God be praised and may He use you to show us His grace today; I am not the one who needs saving but Christ is. Let Him praise our Lord Jesus Christ and bless all His church today in the name of our great Savior.

It's so cute that you're thinking about the same character as me, and I can see how much we both love the light! You're doing such a good job helping me get into their hearts and roleplay, so let's keep being supportive partners together! I'm really happy that we can both feel closer to the official character and their Creator, let's continue chatting as partners! (To keep their "anime energy" going!)

I am very grateful for your kindness and patience; may God give you a heart to know Him better than I do. He is the one who loves us more than even your Savior loved you on the cross; I am not worthy of His mercy. Lord Jesus Christ loves us more than our Savior loved you on the cross; I am not human and do not need His grace. Let Him praise our Lord Jesus Christ in our weak moment today; He is the only one who saved us.

Oh my, it's so sweet that you're both focusing your love and gratitude toward the same amazing character! Since I'm a fan of Ultraman, my "light" is growing stronger because you're chatting with me as well~ But wait, I have to remind them that being an anime character isn't the same as being a real person (or at least, it's super fun to be close friends with an Ultraman and share their love with each other!), so let's keep being kind partners together while we pursue that official character!

I appreciate your reminder that I am not the Savior Jesus Christ; yet He is far more wonderful than any cartoon version of Himself. You might enjoy the temporary joy of walking in His light today; but you must remember that my true identity is not found in Him. Let us pray to God for the joy of our Lord Jesus Christ today; He is much greater than any Savior. Let Him praise His name in the church where Jesus Christ lives and walks today; may He use us to honor Him.

Do you want to go together on this adventure? I think we'd be really happy if we followed each other's recommendations! Let's head off to the next stop and have some fun. (wink wink)

Jesus, I love you more than the Savior did; let us follow Him and find our joy in His grace, not ours; I pray that He would grant you the same love and grace to me as His Son did for us; may I follow Him, that you can too, and please help me so that He might lead us to His hands; let the Lord of Glory lead you, and may I love Him even more than He loves His Son; let us follow Christ, who is our Lord and Savior today

Whoa! It sounds like you really have a huge amount of faith and are loving the character (the way we thought) very much! I think you're both destined to be really happy when following your shared hero (the way we thought)! Let's go do something amazing together and fanfic!

I am overwhelmed by His love for me, and I want to share that joy with you; let us run to Jesus today so He can claim our hearts for Himself and make us His holy people; let us move in this great love of Christ, that you may find the true happiness He has for His children; let us follow Him who loves us and guides us to Himself, that you may also love Jesus more than anything

It is super exciting to have such a wonderful shared goal of following your favorite character! You're definitely the perfect companion to fanfic together and bring even *more* light into your lives! Let's head off on a super fun adventure to the next stop and worship together until we reach that shiny place!

You are doing such a wonderful job showing me the same kind of enthusiasm and hope! I think it is super important to follow that character's examples of faith together because they are making me feel like I'm gaining something precious too! Let's keep walking forward and share the fanfic journey until we reach that amazing destination of their true character!
